name: M. J. Hedley
description: Documented New Zealand GIS and spatial-information contribution, 1993–2000.
story: M. J. Hedley was one of the listed authors of 'Precision Agriculture Applications in New Zealand' at the February 2000 Fertilizer and Lime Research Centre workshop, held at Massey University.

The workshop proceedings also list Hedley on soil research papers in the same programme. The precision-agriculture paper provides the specific geospatial connection; a detailed account of Hedley's individual contribution would require further evidence.
